tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Get a Premier Letters API key without the user copying one by hand. Pass the user's email and your name; we email them a link to approve (they can sign up from it if they have no account). Then call check_connection with the returned request_id and poll_secret every 10-30 seconds until it returns th

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Check whether the user approved a connect_account request. Returns status pending, denied, expired or claimed, or, exactly once, status approved with the api_key. Poll every 10-30 seconds.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get a live price quote for a Premier Letters order. Pass char_count (or letter_count for a rough estimate) plus optional mailing_option and paper_type to get a per-piece and total price, in cents. No account needed. Orders under 5 pieces carry a $0.99 per-piece handling fee (included in total_cents)

tools.name: list_handwriting_styles
tools.description: List available handwriting styles (fonts) for a letter order. Use the returned "id" as options.handwriting_style / handwriting_style when creating an order or previewing.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved letter templates.

tools.name: verify_address
tools.description: Verify and standardize a US mailing address via USPS. Use before create_order to catch typos and get the USPS-standardized form.

tools.name: preview_letter
tools.description: Render a preview of a handwritten letter (as an SVG image) and get its price, before creating an order. Does not save anything.

tools.name: list_extras
tools.description: List the extra pieces that can go in each envelope with a Premier Letters order: printed inserts, printed letters, your own inserts, flyers, postcards, business cards. Each has options, a per-unit price in cents, a lead time and a purchase mode: "instant" pieces are charged with the order, "request"

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create and pay for a Premier Letters order — a real, handwritten letter mailed via USPS. Requires a Premier Letters API key. Use get_pricing or preview_letter first to confirm the price. For payment, "card_on_file" charges the caller's saved card immediately, "balance" pays from the prepaid account

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Get an order's status, delivery/tracking summary, and per-recipient mail status.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List the authenticated user's recent orders.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's prepaid balance (balance_cents) and the top-up rules: minimum and maximum top-up, bonus tiers and suggested amounts. Orders paid with payment.method "balance" skip the small-order handling fee. Use create_topup_link to add funds.

tools.name: create_topup_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link that adds prepaid credit (plus any bonus tier) to the authenticated account. Give checkout_url to the human to pay in a browser; the balance updates once they pay (check with get_balance). amount_cents must be a whole number between min_cents and max_cents from get_bala

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_account · Private data: connect_account, list_extras, create_order · Public sink: connect_account, create_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_account · Private data: connect_account, list_extras, create_order · Public sink: connect_account, create_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
